name: api
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project api --web

build.// env: Nx auto-loads the workspace-root .env, which sets NODE_ENV=development for local dev convenience (next dev, db scripts, etc.). That value leaks into every task Nx runs, including this one. `next build` run with NODE_ENV=development (any bundler, Turbopack or webpack) crashes prerendering the synthetic /_global-error route with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading useContext)' -- confirmed on Next.js 16.1.7 and 16.3.6. Forcing NODE_ENV=production here (the executor's `env` option takes priority over .env files) fixes it outright; no bundler override is needed. Turbopack, the project default, is kept.
